description: The phone's own host as a page: its name in the mesh, its ssh key, the agents that run on this phone, and the phone's trash. Opened from the home screen's header; the phone's agents are also listed on the home screen under the host "local".
opens: the "This phone" button (phone icon) in the home screen's header bar, left of ⋮

parts.name: Bar
parts.shows: Title "This phone" and a back button at the start; nothing at the end.

parts.name: New Agent
parts.shows: No New Agent button, screen or empty-list button: an agent on this phone is made as on any host, with New session and "local" picked beside it.

phone.why: The desktop has no New Agent; the owner dropped it

parts.name: Name row
parts.shows: A rounded group of one row, as a Settings row: "Name" at the start, the phone's name in the mesh at the end (dim, its own name in Android's settings, else its model's, until it's renamed) and a › after it. No line under it.

phone.does: a Settings-style Name row, tapped to rename
phone.why: The owner asked for a Name row like a Settings row, label left, name right, customisable

parts.name: Rename dialog
parts.shows: Title "Rename <name>"; a text entry holding the current name, its placeholder the name Android gives the phone. Buttons Cancel and Rename (suggested); Done renames.

actions.does: keeps the name (spaces tidied, 64 characters at most; left empty, the name Android gives it again), tells this app's heads and publishes the phone's mesh record anew, so every member of the mesh lists the phone by the new name

parts.name: Key Material
parts.shows: Heading "Key Material", then a rounded group: the phone's ssh public key as an authorized_keys line (ecdsa-sha2-nistp256 <base64> baude@<model>) in the code font on a raised block, selectable; under it Copy and New Key. While the phone has no key: Make Key alone ("Making the key…" while it's made). If the Keystore can't be read: why, in red, and Try Again. No caption or instructions.

actions.does: makes a key in the Android Keystore and tries each host again with it

phone.does: This phone holds the key; Add Host has none of it
phone.why: The owner: the phone's key belongs on the phone's page, not in Add Host

parts.name: New Key dialog
parts.shows: Title "Make a new key?"; body "The old key can't be recovered. You will have to re-authenticate into your mesh." Buttons Cancel and Make Key (destructive).

actions.does: makes a new key in place of the old one and tries each host again with it

parts.name: Agents
parts.shows: Shown only while this phone has an agent that is not archived. Heading "Agents", then a rounded list of them. Each row, one line: the agent's picture (or initials), set into the page: see README's A picture is set into the page, then for a Bot its name alone (never its chat's title), else its title, else its model's name ("Agent" if none); its status dot (with the asking mark when it asks something), and a trash button. No second line.

actions.does: opens the agent's chat (a chat on host "phone")
picks an image from the phone, shrinks it to a PNG 256 across at most and sets it as the Bot's picture
asks to move it to this phone's trash (below)

parts.name: Models
parts.shows: No Models section: the models the mesh serves are in the model picker's list.

phone.why: The owner dropped it: models are visible in the model picker

parts.name: Trash
parts.shows: Shown only while the phone's trash holds an agent. Heading "Trash", then a row per trashed agent, newest first, one line: for a Bot its name alone, else its title, else its model's name ("Agent" if none); and a Restore button.

actions.does: restores its transcript, folder, picture and senders where they were and lists it again in Agents

parts.name: Move to trash dialog
parts.shows: Opened by an agent's trash button. Title "Move “<name>” to the trash?" (name: the Bot's, else "this session"); body: its transcript, its memory and the files in its folder will be moved to this phone's trash, where you can restore it. Buttons Cancel and Move to Trash (destructive).

actions.does: asks the phone's host to delete the session, which moves its files to phone/trash

parts.name: Chats with a phone agent
parts.shows: Its sessions are listed on the home screen under the host "local" (this machine, as Baude names its own) like any host's and open as an ordinary chat; the mesh knows the host by the phone's name. They differ from a chat on another host: the agent's loop and tools run on this phone, in its own folder; its model calls go through the mesh to a machine that serves the model, so only models the mesh serves can be picked, and none served means it cannot start; there is no connection banner for the host since it is the app itself; going back to an earlier message (rewind) is not supported; and a Bot's globe button is shown as in any Bot chat (PhoneUse.page.json).
text: an agent on this phone can't be taken back to an earlier message yet

states.name: nothing yet
states.shows: Only the bar, the Name row and Key Material: no agents and an empty trash
